summary: [¶] Petition for truing up of the transmission tariff for the 2019-24 tariff period and determination of the transmission tariff for the 2024-29 tariff period under Section 62 read with Section 79(1)(d) of Electricity Act, 2003 and under the Regulation 15(1)(a) and Regulation 23 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2023 read with the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Condition of Tariff Regulations) 2019 and the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Condition of Tariff Regulations) 2024 for the Asset under “Eastern Region Strengthening Scheme-XXIV (ERSS-XXIV)” in the Eastern Region. [¶] The instant Petition has been filed by Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (PGCIL) for truing-up of the transmission tariff for the 2019-24 period and for the determination of the transmission tariff for the 2024-29 period for the Asset “Shifting of 400 kV side of 400/220 kV, 315 MVA ICT-I at Durgapur from Bus Section-A to Bus Section-B” under “Eastern Region Strengthening Scheme-XXIV (ERSS-XXIV)” in the Eastern Region along with the following prayers: [para 2] 2. The Petitioner, vide affidavit dated 16.5.2025, has submitted as under: [¶] (a) The Commission in order dated 6.6.2024 in Petition No. 289/TT/2023 approved the transmission tariff for the 2019-24 period for the Asset: Shifting of 400 kV side of 400/200 kV, 315 MVA ICT-I at Durgapur from Bus Section-A to Bus Section-B (without physically shifting the transformer) under the project “ERSS-XXIV” and directed the Petitioner to file the truing-up Petition for the 2019-24 period for the said asset in its original project Petition, i.e., under “Farakka I & II Transmission System”. [¶] (b) Due to inadvertent oversight of the aforesaid Commission’s order, the Petitioner filed Petition No. 21/TT/2025 (Diary No. 605/2024) for truing up of the said transmission asset under project “ERSS-XXIV”. Upon the discovery of the inadvertent error, the Petitioner, in compliance with the Commission’s direction, filed the truing up Petition No. 375/TT/2025 (Diary No. 1274 of 2024) for the said asset under the project “Farakka I & II STPS Transmission System”. The inadvertent error has been explained in Petition No. 375/TT/2025. [¶] (d) Accordingly, the instant Petition, i.e., Petition No. 21/TT/2025 [para 4] 4. Considering the said inadvertent error and keeping in view that the Petitioner has already claimed the transmission tariff covered in Petition No. 21/TT/2025 in its another Petition No. 375/TT/2025 in compliance with the Commission’s direction, the Petitioner is permitted to withdraw Petition No. 21/TT/2025. [para 6] 6. Petition No. 21/TT/2025 is disposed of as withdrawn.
